edits.original: Access checks default to fail-closed, rather than open.
edits.reason: The "rather than open" trailer is a redundant antonym tacked onto the sentence: "open" is the ordinary, general-knowledge antonym of "fail-closed" that anyone with basic tech literacy already knows, so the clause adds nothing and is cut per Rule 3.

edits.original: Those privilege limits are imposed on purpose, rather than by accident.
edits.replacement: Those privilege limits are imposed on purpose.
edits.reason: The "rather than by accident" trailer is a redundant antonym clause: "on purpose" and "by accident" are ordinary-knowledge opposites that virtually anyone knows, so the bolted-on distinction adds nothing and is cut per Rule 3.
